reviews.text:
Dear Dániel!

Thank you very much for the five stars!🤩 ❤️ We are very happy that you were satisfied with us and that you chose us. We wish you many happy and enjoyable dog walks together in the future! 🐾

Best regards
Petneházy Tekla

We were looking for a nearby dog ​​school where we could start our puppy at a very young age, so that he could socialize as soon as possible, meet other dogs and owners, and also situations and tasks that can occur in everyday life.

Before we started going, we talked to the head of the dog school, Tekla, by phone. She answered all our questions very willingly, and her attitude was friendly from the first conversation.

Since then, we have been attending the classes regularly. We really like the good atmosphere, the company, and the fact that our dog can meet many different dogs, while we can also talk to other owners and exchange experiences. Overall, we feel very good, we are satisfied, and we are glad that we chose Strázsa Dog School.

Strázsa dog school not only educates puppies, but also provides us, the owners, with good advice. Our unruly Folki has become a real pack dog, and our Lizzy from Szeleburd has also learned to walk without a leash. Although they are no longer with us, we chose Strázsa with our current dogs.
Jorgosz really loves going to the classes. Everyone is nice and the exercises are useful!!🥰 We wholeheartedly recommend Strázsa Dog School!
Tekla is very conscientious and super kind with the dogs, we learned a lot with Kifli during the 1st and 2nd individual lessons! I can only recommend her!

I highly recommend Strázsa Dog School! Tekla is a very kind, patient and knowledgeable instructor who cares deeply about both dogs and their owners. Every session is held in a good mood. We always get useful advice and you can feel that the success of every dog ​​is truly important to her. We are glad that we chose Strázsa, I highly recommend it to anyone who wants a happy, balanced dog and an even better relationship with them 🐶❤️
They are very helpful and the atmosphere is always great. We have brought many of our dogs here and have been coming here for years and I can only recommend it to all dog owners🦮🐶 …

We adopted Mázli two months ago. We would like to teach her basic things.
That's why we started looking for a dog school. We found Strázsa Dog School, which seemed like an ideal choice for us.
When we inquired by phone, we received correct and satisfactory answers to all our questions.
We have been attending the school with our dog for two weeks now, and we are extremely satisfied with the lessons. Every exercise and task provides a solution to dog problems that occur in everyday life.
Our instructor, Tekla, has a lot of expertise, love for animals, and cheerfulness that helps us, novice owners.
If anyone is looking for a dog school, feel free to apply to Strázsa Dog School!
Gyöngyi, Gábor

We started dog training with our puppy Chili a few weeks ago, which not only he but we love.☺️ The classes are great, Tekla and Kriszti always pay attention to everyone and the tasks are varied. Chili also has little friends, they are super cute playing before and after class:) I recommend them to everyone☺️

Tara and I really love dog school, both owner and dog receive enjoyable and useful knowledge, I like the flexibility and the fact that here the little apprentices become real, life-trained dogs that can move around the city comfortably, and the atmosphere is second to none.
